units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 12:9">Gen. XII, 9</cite>) <he>מְהַקֶּה והולך וכ׳</he> surveying as he went along, with the direction towards the Temple.

senses.gloss: to imitate a person’s customs, to follow a person’s footsteps. Sifra K’dosh. beg. (ref. to Lev. XIX, 2) פמליא של מלך מה עליה להיות מְחַקָּה למלך Rab. (ed. פ׳ למלך ומה וכ׳) what is the duty of the King’s retinue?—To follow in the wake of the King; (Yalk. Lev. 604 מְחַכָּה).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:9">Ḥull. II, 9</cite> <he>שלא יְחַקֶּה וכ׳</he> that he may not appear to imitate the customs of the heretics.
